app.title: Moldova EV Overview
hero.subline: Comparing fuel cost vs. electricity at today's ANRE prices — adjust below for your exact profile.
tax.basisNote: EVs are taxed by vehicle mass; ICE cars are taxed by engine displacement. Rates are identical in structure but applied to different bases.
tax.masaQuestion: What is the maximum authorised mass?
tax.masaExplainer: The maximum authorised mass is the maximum permissible loaded mass of the vehicle — not the unladen (curb) weight.
tax.talonInstruction: Find the maximum authorised mass on your vehicle registration certificate.
tax.talonHint: On the talon it is labelled «Masa totală maximă admisă» or field G.
savings.maintenanceNote: And that's before maintenance — EVs have ~70% fewer moving parts, meaning significantly lower servicing costs year after year.
savings.breakEven: You recover the investment in {{months}} months
co2.treesEquivalent: Equivalent to {{count}} trees planted per year
co2.kgEmissions: Your current car emits ~{{kg}} kg CO₂/year — an EV would produce zero direct emissions.
co2.negligible: Minimal CO₂ impact at this profile
